@@U00885@@
(Turning toward the table.)

@@U00886@@
Jesus! I wonder if the wine’s still flowing!

@@U00888@@
It was all a trick, a sham, a lie.

@@U00890@@
And yet I thought I was drinking wine.

@@U00892@@
And what was all that with the grapes?

@@U00894@@
And they say there’s no such thing as miracles!

@@U00896@@
A low hearth with a large cauldron over the fire. Various apparitions, scorpions, salamanders, etc., are seen in the steam rising from it. A FEMALE MONKEY sits beside the cauldron, skimming it, taking care it doesnt boil over. A MALE MONKEY sits nearby with the young ones, warming himself. Walls and ceiling are decorated with the strangest implements of witchcraft. Enter 浮士德 and 梅菲斯特.

@@U00898@@
I’m sick of it! Sick of this insane witchcraft! You promise me I'll recover in this chaotic madness. How? By begging for aid from some ancient hag’s remedy? A filthy brew will take thirty years off my back? I pity myself if you can think of nothing better. No, I’ve already lost hope. Is there no natural way to this end? Has no noble mind discovered some healing balm?
translation:
@@U00885@@
（转向桌子。）

@@U00886@@
天啊！我想知道酒还在流吗！

@@U00888@@
这全是一个诡计、一个骗局、一个谎言。

@@U00890@@
但我以为我在喝酒。

@@U00892@@
葡萄到底是怎么回事？

@@U00894@@
他们说世界上没有奇迹！

@@U00896@@
一个低矮的壁炉，火上有一个大锅。从它升起的蒸汽中可以看到各种幽灵，蝎子，火蜥蜴等等。一只母猴坐在大锅旁边，撇油，小心不要让锅溢出。一只雄性猴子和幼猴坐在附近取暖。墙壁和天花板上装饰着最奇怪的巫术工具。浮士德和梅菲斯特登场。

@@U00898@@
我受够了！厌倦了这种疯狂的巫术！你向我保证我会从这混乱的疯狂中恢复过来。如何？向一些古老的女巫寻求帮助？一杯肮脏的啤酒会让我减掉三十年的时间吗？如果你想不出更好的办法，我真可怜我自己。不，我已经失去了希望。难道没有自然的方法可以达到这个目的吗？难道没有高尚的心灵发现了某种治愈药膏吗？
